title: Lesson 22: IP Design: Server-Side Orchestration
description: Design and configure server side processes to integrate and orchestrate data between systems.

questions.question: What is an Integration Procedure?
options: A declarative server-side process executing multiple actions in one call
questions.explanation: IPs orchestrate multiple actions server-side in a single transaction.

questions.question: Why use an IP instead of multiple callouts from a FlexCard?
options: One server call executes the orchestration. Fewer round trips, consistent handling
questions.explanation: IPs consolidate orchestration into one server call.

questions.question: Which order reflects a typical IP flow?
options: Extract → Transform → External call → Load → Respond
questions.explanation: IPs flow data forward: extract, transform, integrate, persist, respond.
